name: Hauranne Balzola
source:
A teacher at Symphonia Magic Academy who specializes in fortune-telling magic. 
He has sub events in Mahoutsukai to Goshujin-sama and Crimson Empire, and endings in Mahoutsukai to Goshujin-sama, but does not have a full route in either visual novel.
